pNone_chapter_1: Byomkesh and Ajit sit on a patterned rug inside a spacious room of an ancient ancestral home, surrounded by festive decorations and clay tea cups. Byomkesh, lean and sharp-eyed in a crisp white dhoti-kurta, leans back thoughtfully while Ajit sits beside him, observing the bustling activity visible through the open doorway. Warm afternoon sunlight filters through tall, slatted windows, illuminating the dust motes and the vibrant floral garlands draped along the walls. In the background, the blurred figures of wedding guests move through the courtyard, accompanied by the suggestion of a distant musical performance. The atmosphere is one of calm anticipation amidst the lively preparations of a traditional Bengali celebration.
